predictions.claim: JEPA / world-model approaches will eventually replace large language models as the dominant AI paradigm.
predictions.speaker: Yann LeCun
predictions.notes: LeCun frames this as the eventual outcome — initially complementary, later replacement.

predictions.claim: Reliable agentic systems are impossible without the ability to predict the consequences of actions — pure LLM/VLA agents will not get there.
predictions.speaker: Yann LeCun
predictions.notes: Falsifiable by a non-world-model agent reaching demonstrable long-horizon reliability.

predictions.claim: Self-supervised joint-embedding methods (DINO/JEPA line) will continue to overtake supervised baselines across vision tasks now that DINOv3 has reached parity on ImageNet.
predictions.speaker: Welch Labs narrator (implicit framing)
predictions.notes: Check next-gen DINO/JEPA leaderboards vs supervised SOTA on classification, detection, segmentation.
